title: Hostile Neural Network: Opposing Force
description: Hostile Neural Network: Opposing Force is a mod that integrate the dynamics of HNN with the mobs of the new mod Opposing Force for Minecraft 1.20.1. HNN allows you to train data models and run simulations, producing mob predictions, and generate mob loot.
body:
Hostile Neural Network: Opposing Force is a mod that integrate the dynamics of HostileNeuralNetwork[required] with the mobs of the new mod Opposing Force[required] for Minecraft 1.20.1

![Witch data model](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2abe279059af7156f218b3454cb1218ab30c167c.png)

HNN allows you to train data models and run simulations, producing mob predictions, which can be used to generate mob loot.

![Dicer data model](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e43e943ea4c122b158672c0e665405058c8a254.png)

This mod implements the data model of the mobs of Opposing Force's mod, giving them the classical way of being farmed with HNN, training data model of each mob of Opposing Force, producing each prediction with a modified loot for their prediction drop.
